test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Pride
solution:
The correct answer is: **Modesty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pride"** means a feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of one's close associates, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired. (गर्व)

 
 
• **Example:** She felt a great sense of **pride **when she graduated from university.
 
 
 
• **"Modesty"** refers to the quality of not being too proud or confident about yourself or your abilities; humility. (विनम्रता)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite her success, she always maintained an air of **modesty**.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Pride'** is **'Modesty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aristocracy** (अभिजात वर्ग): The highest class in certain societies, typically comprising people of noble birth holding hereditary titles and offices.

 
 
• **Example:** The **aristocracy **often held significant power and influence in historical societies.
 
 
 
• **Attraction** (आकर्षण): A quality or feature that evokes interest, liking, or desire.
 
 
• **Example:** The park's main **attraction **is its beautiful botanical gardens.
 
 
 
• **Assurance** (आश्वासन): A positive declaration intended to give confidence; a promise.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him her **assurance **that she would be there on time.
